nodes.name: Convection
nodes.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock, Lightning Bolt, Lava Burst, and Chain Lightning spells by 2%.

nodes.name: Concussion
nodes.desc: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Earth Shock spells by 1%.

nodes.name: Reverberation
nodes.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Shock spells by 0.2.1 sec.

nodes.name: Elemental Alacrity
nodes.desc: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst spells by 0.2.2 sec.

nodes.name: Call of Flame
nodes.desc: Increases the damage done by your Fire Totems and by your Flame Shock, Fire Nova, and Lava Burst spells by 15%.

nodes.name: Elemental Focus
nodes.desc: Gives you a 10% chance to enter a Clearcasting state after casting any Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell.  The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

nodes.name: Elemental Warding
nodes.desc: Reduces damage taken from Fire, Frost, and Nature effects by 4%.

nodes.name: Improved Fire Nova
nodes.desc: Increases the damage done by your Fire Nova spell by 20% and reduces its cooldown by 2 sec.

nodes.name: Eye of the Storm
nodes.desc: Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst by 70%.

nodes.name: Earthbound
nodes.desc: Your Earthbind Totem Immobilizes nearby targets for 5 sec when cast.

nodes.name: Elemental Reach
nodes.desc: Increases the range of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Fire Nova, and Lava Burst spells by 6 yards, and increases the range of your Flame Shock spell by 15 yards.

nodes.name: Lava Burst
nodes.desc: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 143 to 185 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.

nodes.name: Lightning Overload
nodes.desc: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 30% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.

nodes.name: Elemental Fury
nodes.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%.

nodes.name: Earth's Grasp
nodes.desc: Increases the health of your Stoneclaw Totem by 25% and the radius of your Earthbind Totem by 10%.

nodes.name: Thundering Strikes
nodes.desc: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 1%.

nodes.name: Ancestral Knowledge
nodes.desc: Increases your Intellect by 10%.

nodes.name: Guardian Totems
nodes.desc: Increases the amount of damage reduced by your Stoneskin Totem and Windwall Totem by 10% and reduces the cooldown of your Grounding Totem by 1 sec.

nodes.name: Mental Dexterity
nodes.desc: Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 100% of your Intellect.

nodes.name: Improved Ghost Wolf
nodes.desc: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by 3.1 sec, and Ghost Wolf may be used indoors.

nodes.name: Improved Lightning Shield
nodes.desc: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by 5%.

nodes.name: Elemental Weapons
nodes.desc: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Rockbiter Weapon by 7%, your Windfury Weapon effect by 13% and increases the damage caused by your Flametongue Weapon and Frostbrand Weapon by 5%.

nodes.name: Shamanistic Focus
nodes.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock and Lightning Shield spells by 45%.

nodes.name: Anticipation
nodes.desc: Increases your chance to dodge by an additional 1%.

nodes.name: Toughness
nodes.desc: Increases your Stamina by 2%.

nodes.name: Flurry
nodes.desc: Increases your attack speed by 1% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

nodes.name: Stormstrike
nodes.desc: Instantly strike for normal weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

nodes.name: Spirit Weapons
nodes.desc: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active.

nodes.name: Mental Quickness
nodes.desc: Increases your spell damage and healing by up to 30% of your Intellect.

nodes.name: Improved Stormstrike
nodes.desc: When you Stormstrike, you have a 20% chance to gain 50% mana regeneration while casting spells for 15 sec, and Stormstrike's cooldown has a 20% chance to reset each time you Dodge or Parry.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Weapon
nodes.desc: When you deal damage with a melee attack, you have a chance to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

nodes.name: Rage of the Farseer
nodes.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 25 sec.

nodes.name: Improved Healing Wave
nodes.desc: Reduces the casting time of your Healing Wave spell by 0.1.1 sec.

nodes.name: Tidal Focus
nodes.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by 5% and improves your chance to hit by 5%.

nodes.name: Mindfulness
nodes.desc: Allows 5% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

nodes.name: Natural Grace
nodes.desc: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by 30%.

nodes.name: Totemic Focus
nodes.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your totems and any spells that summon or move them by 5%.

nodes.name: Improved Reincarnation
nodes.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Reincarnation spell by 10 min, increases your maximum health by 4%, and increases the amount of health and Mana you reincarnate with by an additional 10%.

nodes.name: Healing Focus
nodes.desc: Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any healing spell.

nodes.name: Water Shield
nodes.desc:
The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's healing spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds.  Lasts 10 min.

Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.

nodes.name: Tidal Mastery
nodes.desc: Increases the critical effect chance of your healing spells by 1%.

nodes.name: Restorative Totems
nodes.desc: Increases the effect of your Mana Spring Totem by 5% and increases the effect of your Healing Stream Totem by 5%.

nodes.name: Healing Way
nodes.desc: Increases the amount healed by your Healing Wave spell by 33%.

nodes.name: Nature's Swiftness
nodes.desc: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

nodes.name: Purification
nodes.desc: Increases the effectiveness of your healing spells by 10%.

nodes.name: Riptide
nodes.desc: Heals a friendly target for 456 to 504, an additional 445 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%.

nodes.name: Improved Wrath
nodes.desc: Reduces the cast time of your Wrath spell by 0.1 sec and its Mana cost by 50%.

nodes.name: Genesis
nodes.desc: Increases the periodic damage and healing done by your spells and abilities by 1%.

nodes.name: Moonglow
nodes.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your damaging spells by 25%.

nodes.name: Improved Moonfire
nodes.desc: Increases the damage and critical strike chance of your Moonfire spell by 2%.

nodes.name: Nature's Majesty
nodes.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with spells and melee attacks by 1%.

nodes.name: Nature's Reach
nodes.desc: Increases the range of your offensive Balance spells by 20% and improves your chance to hit by 4%.

nodes.name: Improved Entangling Roots
nodes.desc: Increases the damage done by your Entangling Roots spell by 75%, and its victims can take up to 75% more damage without interrupting the effect.

nodes.name: Nature's Splendor
nodes.desc: Increases the duration of your Moonfire and Rejuvenation spells by 3 sec, your Regrowth spell by 6 sec, and your Insect Swarm spell by 2 sec.

nodes.name: Insect Swarm
nodes.desc: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit with attacks by 2% and causing 48 Nature damage over 12 sec.

nodes.name: Vengeance
nodes.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane and Nature spells by 20%.

nodes.name: Improved Starfire
nodes.desc: Reduces the cast time of Starfire by 0.5 sec and Starfire has a 15% chance to stun its target for 3 sec.

nodes.name: Overgrowth
nodes.desc: Increases the maximum number of targets you may have affected by Entangling Roots by 2.

nodes.name: Nature's Grace
nodes.desc: All non-periodic spell criticals grace you with a blessing of nature, increasing your spellcasting speed and reducing your global cooldown by 10% for 3 sec.

nodes.name: Eclipse
nodes.desc: Your Wrath spell reduces the cast time of your next 2 Starfire spells by 0.2 sec. Stores up to 4 charges. Lasts 15 sec.

nodes.name: Moonfury
nodes.desc: Increases the damage done by your Arcane and Nature spells by 2%.

nodes.name: Moonkin Form
nodes.desc:
Shapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing Omen of Clarity's chance to trigger by 100%, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and all party members within 45 yards have their Critical Strike chance increased by 3%, exclusive with Leader of the Pack.  Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and prevents the use of healing spells.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

nodes.name: Ferocity
nodes.desc: Reduces the cost of your Maul, Primal Bite, Swipe, Claw, and Rake abilities by 1 Rage or Energy.

nodes.name: Heart of the Wild
nodes.desc: Increases your Intellect by 10%.  In addition, while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by 20% and while in Cat Form your Strength is increased by 10%.

nodes.name: Feral Swiftness
nodes.desc: Increases your movement speed while in Cat Form by 30%, and increases your chance to Dodge by 4%.

nodes.name: Feral Instinct
nodes.desc: Increases damage done by your Swipe ability by 3% and reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while Prowling as if you were 0.6 levels higher.

nodes.name: Brutal Impact
nodes.desc: Increases the stun duration of your Bash and Pounce abilities by 0.5 sec and reduces the cooldown of Bash by 30 sec.

nodes.name: Thick Hide
nodes.desc: While in Bear Form, Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, or Moonkin Form, you gain 3 additional base Armor per level and another 1.2 base Armor for each point of defense skill beyond five times your level. This amount can be further increased by multipliers from those forms.

nodes.name: Shredding Attacks
nodes.desc: Reduces the Energy cost of your Shred ability by 6 and reduces the Rage cost of your Lacerate ability by 6.

nodes.name: Savage Fury
nodes.desc: Increases the damage caused by your Claw, Rake, Shred, Maul, and Swipe abilities by 20%.

nodes.name: Sharpened Claws
nodes.desc: Increases your critical strike chance while in Bear Form, Dire Bear Form, or Cat Form by 2%.

nodes.name: Primal Bite
nodes.desc: Bite the target, dealing 100% normal damage plus 26 and generating a high amount of threat.

nodes.name: Predatory Strikes
nodes.desc: Increases your melee Attack Power in Cat Form, Bear Form, and Dire Bear Form by 50% of your level.

nodes.name: Leader of the Pack
nodes.desc: While in Cat Form, Bear Form, or Dire Bear Form, the Leader of the Pack increases the critical strike chance of all party members within 45 yards by 3%, exclusive with Moonkin Aura.

nodes.name: Predatory Instincts
nodes.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by 20%.

nodes.name: Rend and Tear
nodes.desc: Increases damage done by your melee abilities on Bleeding targets by 20%.

nodes.name: Nature's Focus
nodes.desc: Gives you a 14% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting Arcane and Nature spells.

nodes.name: Furor
nodes.desc: Gives you a 20% chance to gain 10 Rage when you shapeshift into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. When you shift into Cat Form, you will regain 20% of the Energy you had when you were last in Cat Form, plus 2 Energy for each second you spent not in Bear Form, Cat Form, or Dire Bear Form, up to a maximum of 20 Energy.

nodes.name: Naturalist
nodes.desc: Reduces the cast time of your Healing Touch spell by 0.1 sec and increases all damage you deal by 100%.

nodes.name: Subtlety
nodes.desc: Reduces the threat generated by your Nature and Arcane spells by 30%.

nodes.name: Natural Shapeshifter
nodes.desc: Reduces the mana cost of all shapeshifting by 10%.

nodes.name: Reflection
nodes.desc: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

nodes.name: Gift of Nature
nodes.desc: Increases the effect of all your healing spells by 2%.

nodes.name: Gift of the Earthmother
nodes.desc: Reduces the global cooldown by 0.5.1 seconds on your Rejuvenation, Swiftmend, and Wild Growth spells.

nodes.name: Tranquil Spirit
nodes.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Healing Touch and Tranquility spells by 2%.

nodes.name: Improved Rejuvenation
nodes.desc: Increases the effect of your Rejuvenation spell by 5%.

nodes.name: Swiftmend
nodes.desc: Instantly heals a target with an active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect of one of those spells.

nodes.name: Nature's Swiftness
nodes.desc: When activated, your next Nature spell becomes an instant cast spell.

nodes.name: Living Spirit
nodes.desc: Increases your Spirit by 15%.

nodes.name: Improved Tranquility
nodes.desc: Reduces threat caused by Tranquility by 100% and its cooldown by 60%.

nodes.name: Improved Regrowth
nodes.desc: Increases the critical effect chance of your Regrowth spell by 10%.

nodes.name: Deadly Aspects
nodes.desc: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, Auto Shot has a 10% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by 30% for 12 sec. While Aspect of the Beast is active, all melee auto attacks have a 10% chance of increasing melee attack speed by 30% for 12 sec.

nodes.name: Endurance Training
nodes.desc: Increases the Health and Armor of your pets by 15%.

nodes.name: Focused Fire
nodes.desc: Increases all damage you and your pet deal by 2% while your pet is active.

nodes.name: Improved Aspect of the Monkey
nodes.desc: Increases the Dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey by 4%. Additionally, your pet gains 50% of the effect of your Aspect of the Monkey ability.

nodes.name: Pathfinding
nodes.desc: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by 6%.

nodes.name: Improved Revive Pet
nodes.desc: Revive Pet's casting time is reduced by 6 sec, mana cost is reduced by 40%, and increases the health your pet returns with by an additional 30%.

nodes.name: Bestial Swiftness
nodes.desc: Increases the movement speed of your pets by 30%.

nodes.name: Unleashed Fury
nodes.desc: Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by 20%.

nodes.name: Improved Mend Pet
nodes.desc: Gives your Mend Pet spell a 50% chance of cleansing 1 Curse, Disease, Magic, or Poison effect from your pet each time it heals and reduces the Mana cost by 20%.

nodes.name: Ferocity
nodes.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your pets and hawks by 16%.

nodes.name: Spirit Bond
nodes.desc: While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate 1% of total health every 5 sec.

nodes.name: Intimidation
nodes.desc: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.

nodes.name: Bestial Discipline
nodes.desc: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 100% and allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

nodes.name: Frenzy
nodes.desc: Gives your pet a 20% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.

nodes.name: Bestial Wrath
nodes.desc: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec.  While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

nodes.name: Hawk Eye
nodes.desc: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by 6 yards.

nodes.name: Lethal Attacks
nodes.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 1%.

nodes.name: Improved Stings
nodes.desc: Increases the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by 20%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by 6 sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by 45 sec.

nodes.name: Efficiency
nodes.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by 15%.

nodes.name: Careful Aim
nodes.desc: Increases your Attack Power by 100% of your Intellect.

nodes.name: Rapid Killing
nodes.desc: Reduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by 2 min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot ability within 20 sec by 20%.

nodes.name: Improved Arcane Shot
nodes.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Shot by 1.5 sec. Does not affect the cooldown of abilities which share a cooldown with Arcane Shot.

nodes.name: Lone Wolf
nodes.desc: You deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet.

nodes.name: Trueshot Aura
nodes.desc: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party members within 45 yds by 30.

nodes.name: Mortal Shots
nodes.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by 30%.

nodes.name: Improved Serpent Sting
nodes.desc: Increases the damage done by your Serpent Sting by 10%.

nodes.name: Rapid Recuperation
nodes.desc: Hitting a target with your Serpent Sting ability grants you 50% and consuming Rapid Killing grants you 100% of your Mana regeneration while casting for the next 15 sec.

nodes.name: Barrage
nodes.desc: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 15%.

nodes.name: Scatter Shot
nodes.desc: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec.  Any damage caused will remove the effect.  Turns off your attack when used.

nodes.name: Ranged Weapon Specialization
nodes.desc: Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by 5%.

nodes.name: Sniper Shot
nodes.desc: A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 160 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.

nodes.name: Improved Tracking
nodes.desc: While tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids, or Undead, all damage you deal to the tracked creature type is increased by 5%.

nodes.name: Deflection
nodes.desc: Increases your Parry chance by 5%.

nodes.name: Entrapment
nodes.desc: When your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 5 sec.

nodes.name: Savage Strikes
nodes.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of all your melee abilities by 20%.

nodes.name: Survivalist
nodes.desc: Increases your total Health by 10%.

nodes.name: Improved Wing Clip
nodes.desc: Gives your Wing Clip ability a 20% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

nodes.name: Clever Traps
nodes.desc: Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by 30% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by 30%.

nodes.name: Surefooted
nodes.desc: Increases your hit chance by 3% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by 30%.

nodes.name: Deterrence
nodes.desc: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

nodes.name: Survival Tactics
nodes.desc: Increases your chance to hit with your Trap and Feign Death abilities by 17%.

nodes.name: Predator's Edge
nodes.desc: Increases your melee critical strike damage by 30% and your Off Hand weapon damage by 50%.

nodes.name: Counterattack
nodes.desc: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 26 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

nodes.name: Expose Prey
nodes.desc: Your attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark have a 10% chance to activate your Mongoose Bite for 5 sec.

nodes.name: Survivalist's Discipline
nodes.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by 40%.

nodes.name: Strider Kick
nodes.desc: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec.

nodes.name: Lightning Reflexes
nodes.desc: Increases your Agility by 15%.

nodes.name: Lacerating Strikes
nodes.desc: Your Mongoose Bite also causes the target to Bleed for damage equal to 40% of the damage done by Mongoose Bite over 21 sec

nodes.name: Lightning Reflexes
nodes.desc: Increases your Agility by 15%.

nodes.name: Divine Strength
nodes.desc: Increases your Strength by 2%.

nodes.name: Divine Intellect
nodes.desc: Increases your total Intellect by 2%.

nodes.name: Healing Light
nodes.desc: Increases the amount healed by your Holy Light, Flash of Light, and Holy Shock spells by 4%.

nodes.name: Spiritual Focus
nodes.desc: Gives your Flash of Light, Holy Light, and Light's Vigil spells a 14% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

nodes.name: Improved Seals
nodes.desc: Increases the damage done by your Seals and Judgements by 3%.

nodes.name: Unyielding Faith
nodes.desc: Reduces the duration of Fear and Disorient effects on you by 30%.

nodes.name: Voice of Truth
nodes.desc: Grants you immunity to Silence and Interrupt effects for 6 sec.

nodes.name: Reverence
nodes.desc: Allows 30% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

nodes.name: Purifying Power
nodes.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Cleanse and Purify spells by 20% and reduces the cooldown of your Exorcism and Holy Wrath spells by 50%.

nodes.name: Infusion of Light
nodes.desc: Your Holy Shock and Flash of Light critical hits reduce the cast time of your next Holy Light cast within 15 sec by 1.1 sec.

nodes.name: Divine Favor
nodes.desc: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.

nodes.name: Divine Precision
nodes.desc: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%.

nodes.name: Holy Shock
nodes.desc: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 129 to 139 Holy damage to an enemy, or 110 to 118 healing to an ally.

nodes.name: Consecrated Ground
nodes.desc: Gives your Holy spells 10% increased damage against the first 4 enemies that enter your Consecration.

nodes.name: Holy Power
nodes.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Shock and Holy Strike spells by 15%, and all other spells by 5%.

nodes.name: Light's Vigil
nodes.desc: Applies Light's Vigil to the target for 30 sec. Your next Holy Shock cast on them triggers no cooldown and causes enemy targets to suffer 175 to 189 Holy damage and refund 75% of Light's Vigil's Mana cost, or allied targets to heal their party for 315 to 333. You may only have one Light's Vigil active per party.

nodes.name: Toughness
nodes.desc: Increases your armor value from items by 2%.

nodes.name: Precision
nodes.desc: Improves your chance to hit by 1%.

nodes.name: Guardian's Favor
nodes.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Blessing of Protection by 1 min and increases the duration of your Blessing of Freedom by 3 sec.

nodes.name: Anticipation
nodes.desc: Increases your Defense Skill by 20.

nodes.name: Improved Seal of Fury
nodes.desc: When Seal of Fury's shield is fully absorbed, restore 0 Mana, increased by 15% per level the attacker is above you, up to 45%.

nodes.name: Improved Righteous Fury
nodes.desc: While Righteous Fury is active, all damage taken is reduced by 6%.

nodes.name: Sacred Duty
nodes.desc: Increases your total Stamina by 4% and reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield, Divine Protection, and Templar's Bulwark spells by 60 sec.

nodes.name: Swift Judgement
nodes.desc: Finishes the remaining cooldown on your Judgement ability and reduces the Mana cost of your next Judgement by 100%.

nodes.name: One-Handed Weapon Specialization
nodes.desc: Increases the damage you deal with one-handed melee weapons by 2%.

nodes.name: Improved Hammer of Justice
nodes.desc: Decreases the cooldown of your Hammer of Justice spell by 5 sec.

nodes.name: Templar's Bulwark
nodes.desc: When activated, this ability grants you an absorb shield equal to 100% of your maximum health for 8 sec. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

nodes.name: Iron Creed
nodes.desc: Increases the threat generated by your Holy Strike ability by 30%. While Righteous Fury is active, Holy Strike also reduces your damage taken by 15% for 6 sec.

nodes.name: Holy Shield
nodes.desc: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 110 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active.  Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.

nodes.name: Deflection
nodes.desc: Increases your Parry chance by 1%.

nodes.name: Benediction
nodes.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of all instant cast spells and abilities by 10%.

nodes.name: Improved Judgement
nodes.desc: Decreases the cooldown of your Judgement ability by 1 sec.

nodes.name: Holy Conduit
nodes.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Consecration, Holy Wrath, Exorcism, and Hammer of Wrath spells by 40%.

nodes.name: Conviction
nodes.desc: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 5%.

nodes.name: Sanctified Judgement
nodes.desc: Gives your Judgement ability a 100% chance to return 60% of the Mana cost of the judged seal.

nodes.name: Pursuit of Justice
nodes.desc: Increases movement speed and mounted movement speed by 15%.  This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

nodes.name: Eye for an Eye
nodes.desc: All critical strikes against you cause 15% of the damage taken to the attacker as well. The damage caused by Eye for an Eye will not exceed 50% of the Paladin's total health.

nodes.name: Sacred Arbiter
nodes.desc: Increases the damage of your Holy Strike ability by 20% and causes it to refresh all Judgement effects on the target.

nodes.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
nodes.desc: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 2%.

nodes.name: Vengeance
nodes.desc: Increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by 5% for 30 sec after landing a non-periodic critical strike.  Stacks up to 3 times.

nodes.name: Repentance
nodes.desc: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.

nodes.name: Champion of the Light
nodes.desc: Increases your spell damage by up to 100% of your Intellect.

nodes.name: Instrument of Law
nodes.desc: Reduces the cast time of your Hammer of Wrath by 1.1 sec, and reduces all threat you generate by 20% while Righteous Fury is not active.

nodes.name: Twist of Light
nodes.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your Seal spells by 20%, and when you replace your Seal of Command, Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Fury, or Seal of Justice with a different Seal, you gain an Echo of that Seal. Your next melee attack applies the replaced Seal's effects, consuming the Echo.

nodes.name: Improved Gouge
nodes.desc: Increases the duration of your Gouge ability by 1.5 sec.

nodes.name: Malice
nodes.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 5%.

nodes.name: Ruthlessness
nodes.desc: Gives your finishing moves a 60% chance to add a Combo Point to your target.

nodes.name: Murder
nodes.desc: Increases all damage dealt by 4% against Humanoid and Giant targets.

nodes.name: Improved Slice and Dice
nodes.desc: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 15%.

nodes.name: Improved Expose Armor
nodes.desc: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 10, and refunds 2 Combo Points when cast with 5 Combo Points.

nodes.name: Lethality
nodes.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 6%.

nodes.name: Vile Poisons
nodes.desc: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by 20% and gives your poisons an additional 40% chance to resist dispel effects.

nodes.name: Cold Blood
nodes.desc: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.

nodes.name: Improved Poisons
nodes.desc: Increases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by 10%, and gives Poison applications a 50% chance to not consume a charge.

nodes.name: Vigor
nodes.desc: Increases your maximum Energy by 10.

nodes.name: Mutilate
